_readme: Metrics for the Websites tile on the Desk. Leave a value null to hide it. Any key under `stats` is shown as a chip, in this order: visitors_30d, pageviews_30d, clicks_30d, impressions_30d. `asOf` (YYYY-MM-DD) is shown in the tile header next to the 30-day label. A scheduled GitHub Action can rewrite this file to keep it current.
